title: Public incremental blob read write and size wrappers

scope.rationale: The public read and write wrappers select the checked native payload operation, while the size observer exposes the fixed byte count only until the blob handle has been invalidated.
excluded_responsibilities: Blob open close seek and reopen ownership

external_source_responsibilities: Native Blob handle and shared checked read/write operation
Native Btree cursor payload get and put
dependencies.caller_closure: All three assigned public APIs invoke the production incremental-blob owner used by canonical C clients.

inputs: Nullable blob handle, nullable data buffer, signed amount, and signed offset
outputs: Exact public result code for read/write or current fixed byte length
contracts.ownership: Blob handle and buffers are borrowed. Reads and writes retain the handle; terminal seek/write failure invalidates its cursor without freeing the public handle.
contracts.state_and_results: Negative or out-of-range requests, null non-empty buffers, read-only writes, invalidated handles, and storage failures retain the shared blobReadWrite result policy. Invalidated size is zero.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: The shared owner acquires the connection lock and reads or writes through the positioned native Btree cursor.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Transient range failures preserve the handle. A failed seek permanently invalidates read, write, and reopen until close.

representation_differences: A Zig Blob invalidated flag and optional cursor represent source pStmt validity; both expose zero bytes and ABORT after permanent invalidation.

oracle.protocol: Open a writable and read-only incremental blob, inspect size, read exact content, write replacement content, reject read-only writes, exercise range failures, invalidate with failed reopen, and close safely.
internal_observations: fixed byte count and cursor validity
oracle.normalization: Compare public result codes, byte length, payload content, and post-failure continuation.

assurance.oom: No wrapper allocation; cursor storage errors propagate from the shared owner.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Connection lock and Pager/Btree behavior are delegated to the integrated native owner.
assurance.malformed_input: Null handles and buffers, negative values, range overflow, read-only writes, and invalidated handles are covered.
assurance.continuation: Range errors preserve validity; permanent seek invalidation returns ABORT until close.
assurance.performance: Constant-time wrapper selection and size observation around direct cursor payload access.

integration.native_call_path: Canonical public C exports reach selected schema/table native Btree cursor content through the shared connection-locked owner.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Yes. No separate read/write/size substitute remains.

independent_review.notes: Pinned-C internal trace, assurance, and independent review remain open.
